threshold_note: Engineering acceptance defaults, not empirical guarantees or measurement accuracy. Any evaluator/policy correction creates a new benchmark version and requires affected results to be recomputed.

pilot.historical_baseline_use: visual context only unless equivalence and leakage checks pass
pilot.image_identity: capture ID + source frame ID + source RGB SHA256, not basename or count alone
actual_backend_inputs_required: seed hash and actual initial point count
pilot.candidate_input_rule: Photo sampling/baking/recognition used to color candidates may open only allowed training RGB and train masks; validate before loading files. Camera metadata and declared shared aggregate LiDAR may be shared.
pilot.initial_seed_equivalence: same metric seed positions and color initialization when claiming a controlled backend comparison; record actual loaded counts, caps and defaults
pilot.final_test_history: Previously rendered/viewed/used final-test images are exposed, not automatically sealed. Audit access history; if used for decisions or history is unknown, reserve fresh unexposed trajectory groups before further tuning or mark final-test evidence unavailable.
pilot.validation_critical_rois: Preregister validation ROIs separately before new candidates. Test-only ROIs cannot supply validation selection scores. If validation has no visible critical feature, collect/reserve suitable validation data or remain ineligible; do not drop the feature weight.

surface_builder.color_rule: Interpolate vertex_colours[triangles[owner]] with the sampled barycentric weights. World positions must not be used as RGB.
surface_builder.photo_support_required: Carry source frame ID, supporting triangle/sample, visibility decision and static-mask validity to exported samples. Unseen fallback grey must not count as photo support.
surface_builder.unsupported_samples: Reject/prune before export; all-unsupported input yields explicit no-supported-output failure.
surface_builder.bounds: Enforce positive finite spacing, bounded allocation before np.repeat, max_samples cap, in-range triangle indices, finite colors in [0,1] and safe immutable output destinations.
surface_builder.alpha_calibration: Use real front-to-back transmittance: accumulated alpha = 1 - product(1-alpha_i), with renderer projection/clamping/ordering documented. Sum(alpha_i) is only a density diagnostic, not opacity or brightness.
surface_builder.calibration_model: Representative capped random mesh sampling, orientations, nonuniform density and distances; an infinite square lattice alone does not validate the production sampler.
surface_builder.obsolete_freeze: The prior tangent=0.5, opacity=0.5 freeze is unsupported; recalibrate under a new artifact ID after the compositing/sampling correction.

measurement.cold_scope: Fresh derived caches plus required preprocessing, build/train AND compressed export; time the whole command tree. Report reused immutable source preparation and OS cache limitations separately.
measurement.footprint_aggregate: maximum comparable measured peak across repeats
measurement.viewer_metric: worst session p95 actual rendered-frame time
measurement.ssim_mask_rule: full-image SSIM map; include only windows wholly inside fixed valid mask
measurement.lpips_role: optional fixed diagnostic; not weighted score
measurement.peak_metric: Peak process footprint in bytes across all active child processes, sampled and/or OS peak with method recorded; RSS and footprint are different metrics and must not be silently compared.
measurement.renderer: Use already-built SplatX for common calibrated RGB diagnostics. Validate native preview/export parity and camera conventions; Spark remains required for browser delivery and valid alpha coverage.
measurement.gpu_identity: Record actual renderer/vendor/backend. SwiftShader/software GL, CLI startup latency and rAF callbacks without completed renders cannot provide eligible GPU viewer F.
measurement.viewer_frame_samples: At least 300 completed presented frames in each required 60-second measured session after warmup; preserve timestamps, scene hash, device, resolution and path. If fewer, F is unavailable for selection.
measurement.coverage_alpha: Require genuine accumulated alpha; reject opaque PNG-derived alpha and occupancy inferred from RGB brightness.
measurement.bootstrap_requires: Preserve group IDs and uncertainty intervals; do not treat adjacent individual frames as independent groups.

revision_reason: Audit found geometry encoded as RGB, nonmatching photographic inputs, unsupported mask parity, additive alpha calibration, and incomplete policy enforcement.

execution_contract.entrypoint: One evaluator reads this JSON, validates the evidence, derives gates and writes the result. Arithmetic helpers alone do not implement the policy.
execution_contract.completed_rejected_requires: Completed relevant preflight and honest diagnostic evidence showing rejection, or documented exhausted repair budget with exact blockers; never label all implementation phases complete.
execution_contract.selected_for_review_requires: All numeric and nonnumeric gates, required repeats, minimum score, selection lane and sealed final test pass.
execution_contract.unknown_metrics: JSON null plus a structured reason; reject NaN/Infinity and bool-as-number.
execution_contract.score_output: null unless every required gate is measured and true; no quality or performance ranking from diagnostic-only runs.
execution_contract.frozen_policy_hash_mismatch: fail; change requires a new benchmark version and affected recomputation
execution_contract.failure_exit_code: nonzero for invalid evidence, schema, unexpected files, missing views or violated prerequisites; a measured quality rejection may return success with completed_rejected and null selection score.

mask_contract.unmasked_diagnostic: Use RGB-only train directories without discoverable mask files or alpha, not only omitted JSON fields. Verify the backend behavior.
mask_contract.masked_comparison: Same person masks, exclusion semantics and normalization on both backends. SplatX needs native training integration first.

native_loss_acceptance.excluded_rgb_mutation: With all else fixed, changing only excluded GT RGB leaves the intended masked loss and all parameter gradients invariant within atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5 on deterministic tiny fixtures.
native_loss_acceptance.included_rgb_control: Changing included RGB must affect loss and at least one nonzero gradient.
native_loss_acceptance.all_zero_mask: explicit skip with no optimizer/regularizer update or clear error; never NaN or implicit success
native_loss_acceptance.ssim: Mask full window support or document/test an equivalent exclusion formulation; masked GT must not leak through SSIM neighborhoods.
native_loss_acceptance.execution_paths: Test each enabled path including resident Metal; testing Python metrics is insufficient.

gate_evidence.gate_inputs: Gates are derived by the evaluator from artifacts, not caller-provided pass booleans.
gate_evidence.expected_sets: Require exact equality to expected view and ROI ID sets, including no missing, extra or duplicate images.
gate_evidence.hashes: Verify actual bytes of policy, code, binary, kernel, config, inputs, masks, outputs and evaluator against frozen records before scoring.
gate_evidence.boundary_values: Tests cover exact thresholds and values immediately on both sides; values come from this policy, not duplicated constants.
gate_evidence.numeric_domain: Metrics/resources reject nonfinite and invalid ranges; positive finite cost; alpha in [0,1]; SSIM in [-1,1]; RGB in [0,1]; no NaN coercion through min/max.
gate_evidence.review_evidence: Visual gate requires actual paired images, view IDs, reviewer identity, per-view findings and overall verdict. Do not invent an automated realism score.
gate_evidence.product_scope: Auth, revision, collision, exports and measured geometry must be preserved. Research rejection can finish an experiment, not the photorealistic or accessibility product goal.

priority: source color and photographic input correctness
eligible repeat trials and device acceptance only if earlier evidence warrants
before_each_attempt: write defect/hypothesis and failing test ID
state one change and expected observable result
after_each_attempt: run targeted positive and negative tests
record exact command, exit code, evidence paths and remaining budget
on success checkpoint and advance; on failure update hypothesis without marking gate complete
repair_loop.repair_attempt_limits: Use budgets.max_repairs_per_gate_hypothesis and budgets.max_hypotheses_per_blocker; failed reproduction itself does not license an invented pass.
repair_loop.no_repeated_research: Reuse pinned installed SplatX. Native loss extensions are allowed and do not mean rebuilding a new trainer. No msplat setup or backend shopping for the same blocker.
repair_loop.stopping: Stop expensive experiments on invalid inputs or a reproducible hard-quality failure. Stop at first time/step/memory limit, preserve partial artifacts, and provide the bounded next action.

required_negative_tests.test: Uniform red/green triangle reproduces its supplied color within 1e-6; identical XYZ with different RGB changes output.
Translation and rigid rotation of XYZ leave decoded colors unchanged for fixed barycentric sampling within 1e-6.
Known barycentric weights on three distinct corner colors produce the independently calculated RGB.
All unseen samples fail; mixed support exports only observed, unoccluded static samples with source IDs.
Adding an otherwise valid held-out or extra RGB path to the candidate input allowlist fails before file decoding.
Same filename with changed bytes, duplicated alias or modified camera fails provenance validation.
Training and validation/test sets are exactly disjoint by canonical source identity; permitted aggregate LiDAR explicitly disclosed.
Unmasked mode rejects/disables discoverable masks and alpha; record actual backend mask behavior, not MATCHED constants.
Resident/native masked loss and all relevant gradients pass excluded-region invariance plus included-region sensitivity.
Empty mask and SSIM-boundary cases cannot produce updates from excluded RGB.
NaN and both infinities in every metric path fail; an Inf improvement never clips to a valid high score.
An expected eight-view set with one deleted view, an extra view or a duplicate fails; do not glob whatever exists.
Each missing ROI, missing gate, false gate, tampered hash, missing resource trace or stale cached metric prevents numeric selection score.
Baseline self-score=50; faster blurred candidate fails; invalid values fail rather than producing partial/reweighted scores.
All configured hard numeric thresholds tested exactly and just outside; changing a policy threshold changes the evaluator decision without source edits.
One repeat instead of three, mixed RSS/footprint or missing compression time cannot pass resource eligibility.
Two alpha=0.5 layers composite to 0.75; zero opacity=0; output never exceeds 1; brightness is not alpha sum.
Capped/nonuniform sampler produces independently checked density/coverage; no unsafe pre-cap expansion.
Asymmetric scene and off-center intrinsics detect axis flip, transpose and mirror; projected control points agree within 0.25 px.
Native in-memory versus exported/reloaded PLY preview agrees within 1/255 mean absolute RGB error; constant-color synthetic interior agrees within 2/255; document boundary raster differences.
Opaque RGB export cannot satisfy coverage; repeated stale frames/rAF-only samples and software GL cannot satisfy eligible F.
No automatic scene promotion; original hashes and prior revisions survive failures and reruns; refuse existing output destinations.
Test-only ROIs cannot be used for validation selection; exposed/unknown-history test views cannot be labeled sealed.
